name: Grow into plastics and advanced materials

pages.text: Project — What to understand first$(br2)Polyethylene — Ethylene supply, polymerization and forming the product$(br2)PVC — Vinyl Chloride production and a separate polymer line$(br2)PTFE — Fluorine chemistry, intermediate fluids and acid byproducts$(br2)Epoxy — Two supporting liquid inputs, the final reaction and resin processing

PBI — Several intermediate reactions and suitable advanced chemical equipment$(br2)The quest chapters suggest a useful order for developing these lines. JEI gives the exact machine and voltage for each recipe, including any alternative route your factory can support.

PBI needs more than an IV single-block reactor. Diaminobenzidine and Diphenyl Isophthalate require a Large Chemical Reactor with IV-capable power. The Zinc catalyst in the Diaminobenzidine recipe is not consumed.$(br2)Final polymerization uses IV-capable chemical processing. The chemistry quests consume their 1,000 mB samples, so make extra for production.
